title: Add verUSD and remove Noble USDC in globalfee module
summary: Add Verona USD (factory/xion17grq736740r70awldugfs3mls3stu9haewctv2/verusd, display verUSD, 6 decimals) to the globalfee module minimum_gas_prices at 0.005 base units per unit of gas (0.000000005 verUSD), and remove Noble USDC (ibc/F082B65C88E4B6D5EF1DB243CDA1D331D002759E938A0F5CD3FFDC5D53B3E349) so it is no longer accepted for fees. All prices are in each token base denomination. After the v32 upgrade globalfee params change through MsgUpdateParams, which replaces the full Params, so the remaining values are restated unchanged as read from /xion/globalfee/v1/params at v33: uxion at 0.001, the six bypass_min_fee_msg_types and max_total_bypass_min_fee_msg_gas_usage 1000000. Denominations are in ascending order as the module validation requires.
